1445-2034-4871-8347.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand and a creature card in your graveyard.
1445-2034-4871-8347.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Sela triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

339-677-728-8201.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Jegantha, putting a +1/+1 counter on Grimgrin and untapping it
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

1329-2099-3363.easyPrerequisites: Emry does not have summoning sickness.
1329-2099-3363.description:
Activate Sarcatog by sacrificing The One Ring, giving Sarcatog +1/+1 until end of turn
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast The One Ring from your graveyard this turn.
Cast The One Ring by paying {4}.
The One Ring triggers, giving you protection from everything until your next turn.
Repeat during each of your turns.

2023-3480-4289-4518.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying its mana cost.
Aragorn triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Soldier creature token.
When Kor Skyfisher enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Kor Skyfisher and the Human Soldier token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

955-3490-7075-7763.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature token that has not been tapped this turn.
955-3490-7075-7763.description:
Activate a creature token by tapping it, adding {1}.
The creature's ability granted to it by Tale of Katara and Toph triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-849-2466-3249--52.description:
Activate Honor-Worn Shaku's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Honor-Worn Shaku's last ability by tapping Grimgrin, untapping Honor-Worn Shaku.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, Anax triggers, creating a creature token or a token that adds mana.
If you created a creature token, repeat steps 1 and 2 to sacrifice that token and add an additional mana.
If you created a token that adds mana, instead activate that token to add mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed creature from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature from your graveyard by paying one mana.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

6798-6972-7932.easyPrerequisites: There's an artifact or creature card in your graveyard.
6798-6972-7932.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Ceti Eel.
When Ceti Eel dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Ceti Eel enters, it triggers, causing you to mill two cards and put a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

1263-4871-5147-7316.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion.
When Bloodsoaked Champion dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Rat King trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

661-1387-2100-6898.description:
Cast Searing Touch with buyback by paying {R}.
Electro triggers, adding {R}.
Resolve Searing Touch, dealing 1 damage to any target and returning Searing Touch to your hand.
Repeat.

27-2079-3259.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
27-2079-3259.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Sun-Blessed Guardian // Furnace-Blessed Conqueror as attackers.
Sun-Blessed Guardian // Furnace-Blessed Conqueror triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

1806-2060-2511-6627-7367.description:
Activate Eternal Scourge's scavenge ability, granted to it by Young Deathclaws, by paying {3} and exiling Eternal Scourge from your graveyard, putting six +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler due to The Earth Crystal.
Activate Crystalline Crawler six times by removing six +1/+1 counters from it, adding {6}.
Cast Eternal Scourge from exile by paying {3}.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Eternal Scourge.
Repeat.

240-2292-5470-7297.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, causing you to scry 1
Repeat from step 2.

849-5147-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control a land.
You control another nonland creature.
849-5147-7084.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing another nonland creature.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Anax and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Anax trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

7253-7254-7255.easyPrerequisites: You have two or more opponents.
7253-7254-7255.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Mass of Mysteries triggers twice due to Twinflame Travelers, giving Prismabasher myriad twice.
Declare Mass of Mysteries (if able) and Prismabasher as attackers, attacking the same opponent.
Prismabasher's myriad ability triggers four times due to Twinflame Travelers.
Resolve a myriad trigger, creating a token copy of Prismabasher attacking each other opponent.
When the Prismabasher token(s) enter, they each trigger.
Resolve the first trigger, giving five creature you control +5/+5 until end of turn.
Repeat step 6 for any remaining trigger.
Repeat step 4 for the remaining myriad triggers.
7253-7254-7255.notes: If your commander is attacking, you can boost its power to 21 or higher, which will deal lethal commander damage to an opponent. It isn't required for opponents to not block your creatures, as all the Prismabashers have trample, but it is recommended when possible. When distributing the stat increases, make sure to give the creatures attacking each opponent just enough to deal lethal damage (if able) to maximize the effect. The amount of damage dealt will scale the more opponents you have.

997-3025-4681-5170.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, Bastion of Remembrance triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Bastion of Remembrance trigger.
Resolve the Bastion of Remembrance trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

468-1660.description:
Cast Massacre Wurm by paying {3}{B}{B}{B}.
When Massacre Wurm enters, it's first ability triggers, giving all opposing creatures -2/-2 until end of turn.
All of your opponents' lands die as a state-based action due to having zero or less toughness, as they are creatures due to Natural Affinity.
When the lands die, Massacre Wurm's second ability triggers for each land that dies this way, causing each opponent to lose 2 life for each land that died under their control.

1170-1329-1492-6791.notablePrerequisites: There is at least one additional artifact on the battlefield.
1170-1329-1492-6791.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Welding Jar from your graveyard.
Cast Welding Jar by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Emry.
When Emry enters, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards.
Activate Welding Jar by sacrificing it.
Repeat.

2541-2919-5796.notablePrerequisites: You have at least eight permanent cards in your graveyard.
2541-2919-5796.description:
Activate Benthic Biomancer by paying {1}{U}, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Benthic Biomancer triggers, causing you to loot.
Starving Revenant triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Repeat from step 2.

1479-5621-6662.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-5621-6662.description:
Play Arid Archway.
When Arid Archway enters the battlefield, it, Chocobo Racetrack, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Arid Archway trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Chocobo Racetrack trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Arid Archway from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Arid Archway enters the battlefield, it and Chocobo Racetrack trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

4214-4772-5189-5439.notablePrerequisites: There is at least one removable +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
4214-4772-5189-5439.description:
Activate Ghave's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from a creature you control, creating two 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Activate Adaptive Gemguard by tapping the Saprolings, putting two +1/+1 counters on Adaptive Gemguard.
Activate Utopia Mycon's second ability by sacrificing a Saproling, adding {1}.
Repeat.

2146-4970-5671-5751.notablePrerequisites: You have at least one land card in hand.
2146-4970-5671-5751.description:
Cast Chromatic Sphere from your graveyard by paying {0} and discarding a land card from your hand.
Activate Chromatic Sphere by paying {1}, tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1} and causing you to mill two cards and return a land card from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

49-1601-1651-1799-5359.notablePrerequisites: Illuminor Szeras does not have summoning sickness.
49-1601-1651-1799-5359.description:
Activate Illuminor Szeras by tapping it and sacrificing Threefold Thunderhulk, adding seven {B}.
Activate Soldevi Digger by paying {2}, putting Threefold Thunderhulk on the bottom of your library.
Activate Grenzo by paying {2}, putting Threefold Thunderhulk from the bottom of your library into your graveyard, then putting it onto the battlefield.
When Threefold Thunderhulk enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating three 1/1 Gnome artifact creature tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping Threefold Thunderhulk and a Gnome token, untapping Illuminor Szeras.
Repeat.

uses.n: Ayara, Widow of the Realm // Ayara, Furnace Queen

2105-2438-2923.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Ayara triggers, returning Combat Celebrant from your graveyard to the battlefield and giving it haste.
Declare Combat Celebrant as an attacker, choosing to exert it as it attacks.
Combat Celebrant triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Combat Celebrant, putting a +1/+1 counter on Carrion Feeder.
Repeat each combat phase.

709-1627-2232-4772-4977.description:
Cast Tyvar by paying {2}{G}{G}, which enters with six loyalty counters due to Doubling Season.
Activate Tyvar's third loyalty ability by removing six loyalty counters from it.
Tyvar dies as a state-based action due to having zero loyalty.
Resolve the Tyvar ability, causing you to get an emblem.
Cast Fyndhorn Elves by paying {G}.
Tyvar's emblem triggers, causing the Fyndhorn Elves spell to gain haste, and you to draw two cards.
Fyndhorn Elves enters the battlefield, triggering Cloudstone Curio, returning Llanowar Elves from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Fyndhorn Elves by tapping it, adding {G}.
Cast Llanowar Elves by paying {G}.
Tyvar's emblem triggers, causing the Llanowar Elves spell to gain haste, and you to draw two cards.
Llanowar Elves enters the battlefield, triggering Cloudstone Curio, returning Fyndhorn Elves from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Llanowar Elves by tapping it, adding {G}.
Repeat from step 5.

260-1294-2167-4423-4482.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three Islands and one basic Forest.
260-1294-2167-4423-4482.description:
Activate a Forest you control by tapping it, adding {G}.
Cast Summer Bloom by paying {1}{G}, allowing you to play three more lands this turn.
Play Mystic Sanctuary either from your hand or from your graveyard.
Mystic Sanctuary enters the battlefield, triggering its ability twice, putting Summer Bloom on top of your library from your graveyard.
Activate Mystic Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Waterlogged Grove by paying {1}, tapping and sacrificing it, causing you to draw Summer Bloom from the top of your library.
Activate Squandered Resources by sacrificing Mystic Sanctuary and a Forest, adding {G}{U}.
Play the Forest and Waterlogged Grove from your graveyard.
Repeat.

2457-2713-4474-5153.notablePrerequisites:
Sunstrike Legionnaire does not have summoning sickness.
Paradise Mantle attached to Sunstrike Legionnaire.
2457-2713-4474-5153.description:
Tap Sunstrike Legionnaire to add {G}.
Pay {G} to create a 1/1 Insect token.
Sunstrike Legionnaire triggers, untapping.
Repeat.

1636-3634.notablePrerequisites: Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {3}{U}{U}.
1636-3634.description:
Activate all mana producing creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}{U}{U}.
Cast Venser by paying {2}{U}{U}.
Venser enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Intruder Alarm.
Resolve the Venser trigger, returning Venser from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.
